title: Ride the wave
pitch: About 2 minutes, best while the feeling is still loud. It helps you watch the wave instead of acting from the top of it. It may shift as you go, or not; noticing either way is useful.

cards.prompt: About 2 minutes, best while the feeling is still loud. It helps you watch the wave instead of acting from the top of it. It may shift as you go, or not; noticing either way is useful.

cards.why: A number now lets you compare at the end, whichever way it went.

cards.prompt: What's the feeling, if you had to name it?
cards.why: Naming a feeling takes a little of its power and tells you what you're riding.

cards.prompt: Try one of these now, for a minute or two, then come back.
cards.why: Settling your body first can make a little room to think, even if the feeling stays.

cards.prompt: It may be pushing you to act. What's one thing you'll do, or not do, while it's still here?
cards.why: Choosing your next move on purpose, not from the pull, is the reason to wait.
